name: showcase
description: [Deprecated: use spectra] Screenshots and clips of work in progress get lost in a Downloads folder, so writing about what you built means rebuilding it to capture it. Showcase captured screenshots and video clips during development into a searchable, taggable library. Spectra now covers all of it; migrate with the spectra_library migrate-from-showcase action. Start with /showcase.
